info.zfsSlop: ZFS reserves 1/32 of pool capacity for metadata and COW operations
info.compressionRecommended: Compression recommended for this workload type

beegfs.buddyMirrorMinNodes: Storage Buddy Mirroring requires at least 2 nodes ({{serverCount}} configured)
beegfs.buddyMirrorMinNodesRecommendation: Add a second node or disable Storage Buddy Mirroring
beegfs.strandedDrives: {{stranded}} drive(s) do not fill a full storage target of {{drivesPerTarget}} and are stranded
beegfs.noMdt: No metadata targets configured — enable metadata target sizing to size the MDT
beegfs.mdtUnderMin: Metadata target capacity is below BeeGFS's recommended minimum of {{recommendedMin}}
beegfs.mdtUnderMinRecommendation: Increase metadata target capacity to at least {{recommendedTypical}} (typical recommendation)
beegfs.raidTargetNeedsRaidController: BeeGFS {{level}}: HBA detected. A local hardware RAID target must sit behind a RAID controller, not an IT-mode HBA.
beegfs.raidTargetNeedsRaidControllerRecommendat: Select a RAID controller (PERC, LSI) or switch the level to beegfs_raidz2, which does require an IT-mode HBA.

ceph.ramLow: Ceph: Insufficient RAM per OSD ({{ramPerOsd}} GB). Minimum recommended: 2 GB/OSD.
ceph.ramLowRecommendation: Add more RAM or reduce OSD count. Current: {{osdsPerNode}} OSDs with {{ramPerNodeGb}} GB RAM.
ceph.ramMarginal: Ceph: RAM per OSD is marginal ({{ramPerOsd}} GB). Consider 4 GB/OSD for production.

zfs.occupationHigh: ZFS: Max occupation set to {{maxOccupation}}%. Performance degrades significantly above 80%.
zfs.occupationHighRecommendation: Keep pool occupation below 80% for optimal performance.

controller.raidIncompatible: {{topologyType}}: Hardware RAID controller detected. This topology requires an HBA (IT mode) for direct disk access.
controller.raidIncompatibleRecommendation: Use an HBA like LSI 9400/9500 series or Dell HBA355i. RAID controllers hide disk identity and prevent proper data protection.
controller.hbaWithStandardRaid: Using HBA with standard RAID topology. Consider using a hardware RAID controller for better cache and battery backup.

driveType.smrIncompatible: SMR drive detected: {{model}}. SMR drives cause timeouts and disk ejection during rebuild operations.
driveType.smrIncompatibleRecommendation: Use CMR (Conventional Magnetic Recording) drives for ZFS and S2D pools.
driveType.smrWarning: SMR drive detected: {{model}}. SMR drives have poor random write performance.
driveType.smrWarningRecommendation: Consider CMR drives for better performance and reliability.

sectorSize.deprecated512n: Drive uses 512n sector size. Modern systems prefer 512e or 4Kn.
sectorSize.deprecated512nRecommendation: For new deployments, consider drives with 4K native sectors for best performance.

s2d.cacheLow: S2D: Less than 2 cache drives per node ({{cachePerNode}}). Microsoft recommends minimum 2.
s2d.cacheLowRecommendation: Add more cache drives for better write performance and protection.
s2d.cacheRatioLow: S2D: Cache ratio is less than 10% ({{cacheRatioPct}}%). Performance may be impacted.
s2d.cacheRatioLowRecommendation: Increase cache tier size to at least 10% of capacity tier.
s2d.threeWayMinNodes: S2D: Three-way mirror requires at least 3 fault domains (nodes); {{faultDomains}} configured.
s2d.threeWayMinNodesRecommendation: Add nodes or switch to a two-way mirror.
s2d.parityMinNodes: S2D: Single parity requires at least 3 fault domains (nodes); {{faultDomains}} configured.
s2d.parityMinNodesRecommendation: Add nodes or switch to a mirror resiliency.
s2d.dualParityMinNodes: S2D: Dual parity requires at least 4 fault domains (nodes); {{faultDomains}} configured.
s2d.dualParityMinNodesRecommendation: Add nodes or switch to a mirror resiliency.
s2d.mapMinNodes: S2D: Mirror-accelerated parity requires at least 4 fault domains (nodes); {{faultDomains}} configured.
s2d.mapMinNodesRecommendation: Add nodes or switch to a mirror resiliency.
s2d.singleParityDiscouraged: S2D: Single parity is supported but not recommended for clustered Storage Spaces Direct — it tolerates only one failure.
s2d.singleParityDiscouragedRecommendation: Prefer three-way mirror or dual parity.
s2d.twoNodeNestedRecommended: S2D: 2-node clusters should use nested resiliency to survive a drive failure during a node outage.
s2d.twoNodeNestedRecommendedRecommendation: Use nested two-way mirror or nested mirror-accelerated parity for 2-node clusters.
s2d.threeWayRecommended: S2D: Two-way mirror tolerates a single failure. Three-way mirror is Microsoft's recommended default for production high availability.
s2d.threeWayRecommendedRecommendation: Switch Mirror Copies to 3-way for two-failure tolerance.

netapp.raidTecRecommended: NetApp: Using RAID-DP with drives > 10TB ({{tb}} TB). RAID-TEC recommended for better protection.
netapp.raidTecRecommendedRecommendation: Switch to RAID-TEC (triple parity) for drives larger than 10TB.

synology.btrfsRecommended: Synology: Using ext4 filesystem. Btrfs provides additional data protection features.
synology.btrfsRecommendedRecommendation: Consider Btrfs for snapshots, self-healing, and advanced protection.

driveCount.s2dMin: S2D redundant configurations require minimum 4 drives.
driveCount.cephMinOsds: Ceph requires minimum 3 OSDs for proper data distribution.

powerflex.hddNotSupported: PowerFlex: HDD drives are no longer supported. Drive "{{model}}" is an HDD.
powerflex.hddNotSupportedRecommendation: PowerFlex requires SSD or NVMe drives. HDDs are not supported in current PowerFlex versions.
powerflex.fg3wayNotSupported: PowerFlex: Fine Granularity mode does not support 3-way mirror. Only 2-way mirror is available.
powerflex.fg3wayNotSupportedRecommendation: Use Medium Granularity for 3-way mirror, or use 2-way mirror with Fine Granularity.

vsan.esaNvmeRequired: vSAN ESA: NVMe drives required. Drive "{{model}}" is {{driveType}}.
vsan.esaNvmeRequiredRecommendation: vSAN Express Storage Architecture (ESA) only supports NVMe drives. Use vSAN OSA for SAS/SATA/HDD configurations.
vsan.esaLowEndurance: vSAN ESA: Drive "{{model}}" has low endurance ({{dwpd}} DWPD).
vsan.esaLowEnduranceRecommendation: vSAN ESA recommends drives with at least 1 DWPD for write-intensive workloads.
vsan.esaMinHosts: vSAN ESA {{level}}: Requires minimum {{minHosts}} hosts, only {{serverCount}} configured.
vsan.esaMinHostsRecommendation: Increase server count to at least {{minHosts}} hosts for this protection level.
vsan.osaHddCacheRecommended: vSAN OSA with HDD: SSD cache tier recommended for performance.
vsan.osaHddCacheRecommendedRecommendation: Add NVMe or SSD cache drives for hybrid configuration. Minimum 10% cache-to-capacity ratio.
vsan.osaMinHosts: vSAN OSA {{level}}: Requires minimum {{minHosts}} hosts, only {{serverCount}} configured.
vsan.osaMinHostsRecommendation: Increase server count to at least {{minHosts}} hosts for this protection level.

longhorn.physicalUsableDesc: Safe app-data ceiling, including snapshot reserve
longhorn.recommendedCommittedDataDesc: Commit this much today; leaves growth headroom
